div.div: مَخْمُولٌ (JK, TA) and مَخْمُولَةٌ, (JK,) applied to a young camel, (JK,) or to a camel, and a horse, (TA,) and a sheep or goat, (شاة, JK, TA,) Having, or affected with, the disease termed خُمَال: (JK, TA:) and so ↓ خَمِيلٌ , applied to a young camel; pl. خَمْلَى. (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
